Proposed as pim.box-contents: No separate platform carrier. Box contents that are products are one more relation group kind (pim.product-relations, one group per kind); contents that are not products are a declared list or long-text attribute (pim.field-types, pim.list-fields).
Inventory correction: family attributes live in the family's data model, not in a global field.
Automatic product numbering: no check yet. Its check (availability) has planned bindings only, so a build that requests it is UNVERIFIED.
Bundles and parts lists (BOM): checked by bom-products (local SQL), lines-resolve (local SQL). No exact-baseline measurement is claimed.
